purpose: Phase-8A stress-adaptation resistance. Represents reduced stress-to-apoptosis conversion / increased sublethal-stress tolerance / delayed apoptosis commitment as an ordinal state producing a BOUNDED resistance modifier. Phase-6 stress values are NEVER overwritten - the modifier is additive and consumed by an adapter. Schematic ordinal only.

coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic reduction in stress-to-apoptosis conversion the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: general stress-response adaptation biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: feeds resistanceToStressAdapter; the Phase-6 stress engine is untouched.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No stress-marker level or conversion rate (all NOT_REPORTED).
